reviewed_scope: Original authored task documents and finite synthetic evidence/export guards; not physical execution, source reproduction or scene qualification

tests.test_semantics: Each method may exercise multiple subcases; method counts are not counts of experiments, raw observations, scientific validations or unique safety proofs

source_comparison.basis: Already accepted complete-source review packet; no publisher documents or held acquisition routes reopened

resolved_findings: Removed stale route filename and ambiguous inherited completion wording
Restricted numerical contexts to source registration and numerical review
Replaced truthy source-event identifiers with structured observed time/raw/clock joins
Required typed observed pose raw parents and revalidated current plan/calibration/coordinate/clock receipts for measurement and analysis
Bound camera metadata and independent repeat records to prospectively approved identities and raw ancestry
Joined flipped-orientation comparisons to distinct mount/calibration epochs, raw parents and the current endpoint
Required exact current admitted-attempt scope for downstream operations and blocked new admission while any prior attempt remains unresolved
Matched measured/terminal status to admitted attempts and retained failures through safety, return and archive checks
Revalidated all four independent observed safety receipts for return and archive, and joined archived final custody to the accepted return
Required the single scoped specimen identity in the admitted inventory
Rejected archive prefix/trailer payloads, header discrepancies, extra members, symlinks, comments and hidden extra fields
Hardened decoded private-path and file-URI checks, Windows case variants, DEL controls and executable/media signatures
Bound every raw endpoint to explicit qualified calibration ancestry, required current interval validity and enforced text identifiers rather than truthy approval flags
covered_failure_classes: Missing or mismatched receipt identifiers, scope, authority roles and epochs
Synthetic evidence mislabelled as authenticated physical evidence
Absent/nonprospective plans and frames/cells/markers represented as independent repeats
Source commands represented as observations, absent readback parents and incomplete conditions
Invalid sign, clock, calibration, geometry, uncertainty or raw-parent joins
Baseline source-stream substitution, fabricated repeat identity and reused flip epochs
Uncertain duplicate admission, terminal relabelling and discarded failed attempts
Unsupported or unaccepted custody, unsafe release and mismatched archive closeout
Actor payload injection, unknown evidence IDs, mutable evidence copies and malformed messages
Exact export membership, traversal, root/ancestor/file symlinks, tampering, size/encoding limits and archive byte-envelope violations
limitations: Finite deterministic guards inspect declared synthetic metadata; they do not authenticate instruments, receipts or facility authorities
The public evaluator/test files do not implement inaccessible actor/evaluator isolation
The checker operates one scoped specimen episode; whole-study cross-specimen aggregation and independent replication are not implemented
No motion planning, robot execution, actuation, fabricated specimen validation, optical/acoustic calibration, physics solver or scientific result reproduction occurred
Acceptance does not resolve physical qualification unknowns or infer missing repeats, thresholds, dimensions, exposure limits or source timing
The five table hashes were recomputed against reviewed factual inventories, not by reopening publisher files
Exact final task archive bytes and task/scene pairing are separate detached finalization checks; no final archive checksum is asserted here
finalization_rule: Rerun both suites and structural verification after any producer or review-file change. Freeze only the exact original-text allowlist. Record actual final ZIP and paired-scene verification in detached receipts so this report has no self-referential package hash.
